results.llm_raw: {"say":"Recipe is mine RuRuRuRu then cut to RuRu----; the existing cutter C1 already produces both halves but neither output reaches the hub, so route its outputs to a free hub inlet.","calls":[{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B85"},"to":{"$ref":"H1"}},"why":"C1's right/kept half (RuRu----) must reach the hub"},{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B84"},"to":{"$ref":"H1"}},"why":"C1's left/waste half must not dead-end and jam the cutter, so also give it an outlet"}]}

{"say":"Nothing reaches the hub as the goal shape: the mined lines run straight to the hub with no cutter, so I convert a pair of parallel live belt runs into the cutter the recipe needs.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B110","B111"]},"building":{"kind":"cutter"}},"why":"the two parallel miner feeders that run toward the hub get a cutter in place so mined shapes arrive cut as the goal half"}]}

{"say":"The hub's three connected inlets are fed by uncut mined shapes, so nothing matches the goal; I'll cut them to RuRu---- by replacing the inlet belt run with a cutter (kept right half) plus a trash on the waste side.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"The recipe needs cut(half=right) from the mined RuRuRuRu; the connected hub inlets carry the uncut shape, so converting them in place yields the goal half on the delivery side and trashes the waste half."}]}

{"say":"The recipe only needs mine+cut, and this mined belt pair to L3 has no cutter in it, so I convert the parallel pair into a cutter stage with the waste side trashed.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64","B69","B70","B81","B82","B90","B91","B97","B98","B105","B106"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Both parallel runs carry the mined shape into L3 but the run has no cutter; replacing the pair in place adds the cutter (waste half trashed) required by the recipe."}]}

{"say":"Cutter C1 already cuts the mined full shape, but its discarded half is still on a belt with nowhere to go, so the cutter jams and the hub receives nothing; put a trash on that waste output.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B84"]},"building":[{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"The cutter's left output is the waste half; trashing it keeps the cutter running so the kept half can travel on to the hub and finally satisfy the RuRu---- delivery."}]}

{"say":"The two parallel runs feeding the balancer are the spot to place the recipe's cut step: convert them in place to a cutter that keeps the right half and trashes the waste.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B69","B81","B90","B97","B105","B64","B70","B82","B91","B98","B106"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Recipe needs exactly one cutter (half=right); the two parallel runs feed the same balancer and together give a wide-enough region for the cutter, with the waste half going to trash."}]}

{"say":"The known delivery cells into the hub are the three inlet belts, so cut them in place with a cutter rather than adding a new parallel line.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":"cutter"},"why":"Recipe needs the mined shape cut in half before delivery; these are the only delivery-side belts we have handles for, and putting all of them in one call lets the cutter span the parallel inlet lanes."}]}

{"say":"C1 already performs the cut, but its outputs lead nowhere: send the kept half to the hub and sink the waste half into the existing trash so the cutter keeps running.","calls":[{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B84"},"to":{"$ref":"H1"}},"why":"kept half of the cut shape must reach the hub inlet"},{"macro":"connect","args":{"from":{"$ref":"B85"},"to":{"$ref":"T1"}},"why":"discarded half must be trashed so the cutter does not back up"}]}

{"say":"The two parallel miner lines (B112…B63 and B106…B64) merge into balancer L3 uncut; convert that merge into the recipe's cut step — cutter with the left half trashed — so the kept half continues on toward delivery.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B112","B105","B97","B90","B81","B69","B63","B106","B98","B91","B82","B70","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left","confirm_waste":true}]},"why":"Both parallel runs feed the same place, so they go in one call; this turns the mined RuRuRuRu into RuRu---- per the recipe instead of delivering it uncut."}]}

{"say":"The only visible belts carry the mined full shape on two parallel runs into L3 but the recipe needs a cut before delivery, so I convert that segment into a cutter in place.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B69","B63","B70","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"}]},"why":"two parallel runs feeding the same balancer: one 2-wide region so the cutter fits, cutting the mined RuRuRuRu into RuRu----"}]}
